summary: Deployment verification of PHED95007 (Next.js SPA + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend health, towns, JWT auth, /api/auth/me all pass. UI login with admin/PhedAdmin@2026 succeeds via /login -> /select-town (single town Thanesar shown) -> /admin PHED Dashboard renders fully with no 5xx responses and no console errors. Admin dashboard endpoints /api/admin/dashboard and /api/phed/dashboard return 200.

issues: With only one accessible town, admin is still shown the Select Town screen requiring a manual click. Review request stated 'Admin with a single accessible town should auto-select' — could be auto-forwarded to /admin for smoother UX. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: Login response returns JWT in field named 'token' (not 'access_token') — non-standard but consistent with frontend AuthContext usage. Documented so future testers use the correct field.
Single-town admins are not auto-forwarded from /select-town to /admin; consider auto-selecting when accessible_towns.length === 1.
seed_data_creation: None. Only pre-seeded town Thanesar (THS) present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a Next.js dynamic-import SPA; first paint shows 'Loading...' briefly — always wait for [data-testid=login-username-input]. Login is rate-limited (10/min, 15-min lock after 5 fails). JWT is returned as 'token' in POST /api/auth/login response. Public base URL: https://phed95007-verify.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin lands on /select-town first even with a single town — click [data-testid=town-card-THS] to reach /admin PHED Dashboard.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Deployment is functional end-to-end.
